label: Numbers, dimensions and figures can be considered by the intellect apart from sensible qualities…
paraphrase: Numbers, dimensions and figures can be considered by the intellect apart from sensible qualities; what the intellect so abstracts is not thereby abstract in reality, and Plato erred in positing that it is.
note: Source reading behind the owner's paradigm that numbers have esse only in the intellect (#1103). It is no premise of any argument. It does not deny that quantity exists in re as an accident of substances.
